purpose: Standard cells whose CDL describes a transistor topology that differs from the cell layout (shared-node m=2 series stacks vs the layout's split stacks). For these cells only, LVS uses the open_pdks transistor-level SPICE definition, which matches the layout. See references/failure-patterns.md, 'sky130 LVS', CDL topology override.

provenance.method: cell-level sweep: every cell extracted alone from the ORFS platform GDS with the flow's Magic options, compared by Netgen (flow compat setup) against the library-normalised ORFS platform CDL and against the layout-normalised open_pdks SPICE
provenance.result: 412 match both references; 10 mismatch the CDL and match the PDK SPICE (listed here); 5 mismatch both (not overridden: dfbbp_1, xor3_4, probe_p_8, probec_p_8, lpflow_lsbuf_lh_isowell_4); 10 have no devices in the CDL (fill, tap, diode_2: not checked)
